long_biography.plain_text:
Guillermo González Nova guided Comercial Mexicana through one of the most consequential periods in the retailer's history. A derivatives loss pushed the group into restructuring, forcing it to reduce debt through asset sales and refinancing. By 2013 the company was recovering under his chairmanship, but its future still required a more fundamental reorganisation.

The decisive change came with the sale of most store assets to Soriana. Selected supermarket formats were separated into a newly listed company, La Comer, which began operations in 2016. González Nova chaired the successor before moving to an honorary role; family members continued executive leadership while he retained a place on its planning committee.
